Comment: Daily close pipeline for the multi-custodian reconciliation service. Defined as a real Amazon States Language document; whether it was executed against a live (moto-mocked) Step Functions state machine in this build, versus run as the equivalent Python call sequence, is disclosed exactly in the README's honest framing section.

IngestCustodianFeed.Comment: Loads the day's custodian position, cash and transaction files.

IngestBookOfRecord.Comment: Loads the internal book of record for the same accounts and date.

MatchAndClassify.Comment: Runs the fast hash-indexed matcher (app/matcher.py) and classifies every difference by named rule.

WriteExceptionsToDynamoDB.Comment: Persists every record's reconciliation status (matched or held, and the rule if held) to the ReconciliationDailyStatus table.
